goal: Make Guix release bitcoind and CLI tools static-pie so they run on old, non-glibc, or minimal Linux systems
Removes the dependency on the host's glibc version, unblocking users on very old or nonstandard distros
reviewability: Review #36193 first since this PR is rebased on top of the still-open toolchain split PR
No blocking issue within this PR itself, CI passes and author is actively responsive
agreement: Broad support with multiple approach and concept ACKs across reviewers (dergoegge, w0xlt, hebasto, jsarenik)
Verified by extensive independent testing across distros and architectures (151henry151, xrviv, 0xB10C, theStack, ketominer)
Unaddressed objection: loss of dynamic NSS module resolution accepted as a documented tradeoff rather than fixed (willcl-ark, sedited)
Nonblocking objection: FORTIFY_SOURCE symbol check loses precision, no full replacement devised yet (hebasto)

categories.name: build
why: P2 because it substantially improves portability of official release binaries for real downstream users
Removes host-library mismatch bugs and reliance on an old pinned glibc, with demand shown by community testers and users like ketominer
Kept at P2 rather than P1 since it's a new capability, not a fix for an active regression, and carries an accepted NSS tradeoff
